entries.text: Unreliable tracking, pose, visibility, or reference lighting can prevent measurement. Region-only lighting changes can still resemble pigment. entries.text: The planner checks confirmed movements, products, and tools against finite methods. Adaptation preserves confirmed steps and prefers the existing product family. entries.text: STEADY compares regional image color against your baseline and chosen target. Untouched skin patches correct global exposure and color changes. A separate patch checks for inconsistent lighting. Progress measures image color, never product quantity, beauty, or completed application.

entries.text: Unreliable tracking, pose, visibility, or reference lighting can prevent measurement. Region-only lighting changes can still resemble pigment. Camera processing, skin appearance, texture, and products also affect readings. These engineering thresholds aren’t calibrated cosmetic assessments. entries.text: The planner checks confirmed movements, products, and tools against finite methods. Adaptation preserves confirmed steps and prefers the existing product family. Light, Build, and Full are visual targets, not calibrated doses. Your chosen photo and assessment describe your physical result.
